title: Upscale & Cool | Walk to Bars | Mins. to Broadway
description:
Welcome to The Vibe Lounge in East Nashville! This clean and classy house sleeps 10 comfortably. It's a short 10-minute Uber ride to Downtown Broadway with bars, shopping and live music all day. Other main attractions include the Grand Ole Opry, Bridgestone Arena, Titans Stadium, Music Row, Vanderbilt & The Country Music Hall of Fame. The Vibe Lounge has a really cool coffee shop & brewery next door with bars and restaurants in walking distance.

The space
PARKING- 

Our garage holds two standard vehicles, smaller SUV's or one mid-sized pick-up truck. The HOA strictly prohibits overnight parking anywhere in the complex other than inside private garages. Limited paid parking is available during the day.

If you’re traveling with a larger group, plan to carpool or use ride share to cut down on vehicles.

Guest access
The entire townhouse and garage is available for use with the rental.
